The '''1959–60 [[Eliteserien|Hovedserien]]''' was the 16th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]].

==Overview==
It was contested by 16 teams, and [[Fredrikstad FK|Fredrikstad]] won the championship, their eighth league title. This was the first season a bronze medal was awarded.
